proposed.text: A sprinklered assembly hall has an occupant load of 480 persons. The most remote point is 55 m from the nearest exit. Under PD 1096 Rule XII, is this travel distance compliant?

options.text: Non-compliant; the 45 m travel distance limit applies regardless of sprinkler protection
Compliant; the 60 m travel distance limit for sprinklered buildings is not exceeded by 55 m
Non-compliant; assembly occupancies have a 30 m special travel limit regardless of sprinklers
Compliant; travel distance limits apply only to buildings with more than 500 occupants

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: PD 1096 Rule XII sets travel distance at 45 m for unsprinklered buildings and 60 m for sprinklered buildings. At 55 m, the hall is below the 60 m sprinklered limit and is therefore compliant. The 480-person occupant load is below the 500-person threshold for a third exit but does not affect the travel distance calculation.
proposed.explanation: The 45 m / 60 m travel distance rule is a two-value paired fact. Sprinkler protection allows the longer 60 m travel distance because suppression delays fire growth, giving occupants more time to reach exits.
